scenarios.title: A｜确认彼此想法
scenarios.setting: 两个人已经稳定约会了一段时间，但还没有明确关系。

turns.text: We’ve been seeing each other for a while now.

turns.prompt: 你想聊聊彼此对这段关系的看法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah. I’ve actually been wondering how you see our relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I’ve actually been wondering how you see our relationship.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I was thinking the same thing. What are we, exactly?

feedback.naturalExpression: I was thinking the same thing. What are we, exactly?
feedback.explanation: “What are we?”是关系对话中确认双方定位的口语说法，“exactly”强调想把关系说清。

choices.text: I’ve really enjoyed this. I’d like to know how you feel about us.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve really enjoyed this. I’d like to know how you feel about us.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Do you see this becoming a serious relationship?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you see this becoming a serious relationship?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: What relationship are we now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I’ve actually been wondering how you see our relationship.
feedback.explanation: “What relationship are we”搭配生硬；想确认关系，可以问“How do you see our relationship?”，让对方说出看法。

turns.text: I think I’d like us to be together officially. How do you feel?

turns.prompt: 关于「确认关系」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like that too.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like that too.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Yeah, I want the same thing.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I want the same thing.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I’m happy to hear that. I’d like us to be exclusive.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to hear that. I’d like us to be exclusive.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: I was hoping you’d say that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was hoping you’d say that.
feedback.explanation: 用过去式开头缓和请求，表达试探或期待，而不是要求对方必须照办。

turns.text: So… I guess we’re officially together?

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方对恋爱关系的确认，会怎么说？

choices.text: I guess we are.

feedback.naturalExpression: I guess we are.
feedback.explanation: “I guess”表示自己的推测，语气比直接断言更轻。

choices.text: Looks like it!

feedback.naturalExpression: Looks like it!
feedback.explanation: “looks like”根据眼前迹象作判断，给结论留有一点余地。

choices.text: Yeah. I’m pretty happy about that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I’m pretty happy about that.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

scenarios.title: B｜讨论关系期待
scenarios.setting: 在“确认关系”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“讨论关系期待”。

turns.text: Now that we’re officially together, I think it’d be good to talk about what we both want.

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: I agree. I think it’s better to be clear about our expectations.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. I think it’s better to be clear about our expectations.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Yeah. What does a good relationship look like to you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. What does a good relationship look like to you?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Is there anything that’s particularly important to you in a relationship?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything that’s particularly important to you in a relationship?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: I’d like us to be able to talk openly if something bothers us.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like us to be able to talk openly if something bothers us.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: What requirements do you have for me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. I think it’s better to be clear about our expectations.
feedback.explanation: “requirements”像列考核条件；谈关系期待可问“What are you looking for?”，语气更贴近交流。

turns.text: Communication is really important to me. I don’t expect us to talk all day, but I don’t like being ignored for days either.

turns.prompt: 你想说说自己的感受或状态，会怎么表达？

choices.text: That sounds reasonable. I feel pretty much the same way.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds reasonable. I feel pretty much the same way.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: I agree. If I’m busy, I’ll try to let you know rather than just disappear.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. If I’m busy, I’ll try to let you know rather than just disappear.
feedback.explanation: “rather than”表示更倾向前面的选择，常用于说明取舍。

choices.text: That’s good to know. I think I need some time to myself sometimes, though.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s good to know. I think I need some time to myself sometimes, though.
feedback.explanation: “good to know”表示这条信息有用，是接收建议或说明后的简短回应。

choices.text: How often would you ideally like us to see each other?

feedback.naturalExpression: How often would you ideally like us to see each other?
feedback.explanation: “How often”问频率，也就是多久一次，而非一次持续多久。

turns.text: Maybe a couple of times a week? But I don’t want it to feel like a rule.

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: Yeah, I’d rather keep it flexible too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’d rather keep it flexible too.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: That sounds good to me. We can figure out what works for both of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good to me. We can figure out what works for both of us.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

choices.text: I agree. I don’t think we need a strict schedule.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. I don’t think we need a strict schedule.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

scenarios.title: C｜暂时不想确定
scenarios.setting: 在“确认关系”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“暂时不想确定”。

turns.text: We’ve been seeing each other for a while. Do you want to make this official?

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I really like you, but I don’t think I’m ready to define the relationship yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really like you, but I don’t think I’m ready to define the relationship yet.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I want to keep seeing you, but I’d like to take things a little more slowly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to keep seeing you, but I’d like to take things a little more slowly.
feedback.explanation: “take things”与“slowly”等搭配时表示关系发展的节奏，适合商量不要进展太快。

choices.text: I’m happy with where we are right now. Could we give it a little more time?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy with where we are right now. Could we give it a little more time?
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: I’m not saying no. I just don’t feel ready to make it official yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying no. I just don’t feel ready to make it official yet.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I don’t want a relationship now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I really like you, but I don’t think I’m ready to define the relationship yet.
feedback.explanation: 这句表示现在不想建立关系；若只是希望放慢进度，应说“take things more slowly”，避免改变原意。

turns.text: Is there something you’re worried about?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己担心的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: Not specifically. I just don’t want to rush into something before I’m ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not specifically. I just don’t want to rush into something before I’m ready.
feedback.explanation: “I’m ready”说明自己已经准备好，可以进入下一步。

choices.text: I think I need a little more time to understand how I feel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I need a little more time to understand how I feel.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: It’s not about you. I’d just rather let things develop naturally.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s not about you. I’d just rather let things develop naturally.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: I want to make sure we’re both looking for the same thing first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to make sure we’re both looking for the same thing first.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I really appreciate you not pressuring me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I really appreciate you not pressuring me.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I’m glad we can talk about it openly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m glad we can talk about it openly.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。
